name: Lorazepam
toxicity: potentially lethal when mixed with depressants like alcohol or opioids
summary: An intermediate acting benzodiazepine commonly known as Ativan. The drug is often prescribed as an alternative to alprazolam. The drug is reported to have sedating, hypnotic, and anxiolytic effects. The drug may induce amnesia and lower inhibitions. It is recommended not to combine the drug with other depressants
advisory: There is a risk of blacking out at higher dosages. 1mg Lorazepam ~= 10mg Diazepam.
doseBasis: NOTE: There is a risk of blacking out at higher dosages. 1mg Lorazepam ~= 10mg Diazepam.

pharmacology.text: Relative to other benzodiazepines, lorazepam is thought to have a high affinity for GABA receptors, which may also explain its marked amnesic effects. Its main pharmacological effects are the enhancement of the effects of the neurotransmitter GABA at the GABAA receptor.

uses.text: Lorazepam, sold under the brand name Ativan among others, is a benzodiazepine medication that possesses anxiolytic, hypnotic, and anticonvulsant properties. It is indicated for the short term treatment of anxiety (including anxiety disorders), insomnia, severe agitation, active seizures including status epilepticus, alcohol withdrawal, and chemotherapy-induced nausea and vomiting.
uses.recreational: Lorazepam is also used for other purposes, such as recreational drug use, wherein it is taken to achieve a high, or when the medication is continued long-term against medical advice.

sideEffects.text: Common side effects include weakness, sleepiness, dizziness, decreased alertness, decreased memory formation, low blood pressure, and a decreased effort to breathe.
